name: Obligations
description: One row per contract obligation/milestone: linked contract, title, owner, due date, status, and evidence note. Status is toggled directly by the operator (e.g. marking an obligation done).

agentPrompts.label: Log a new obligation for a contract
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the obligation or milestone I describe for the contract I name, with owner and due date, so it shows up in the tracker. This app never creates obligations from its own UI — writing the record directly is the intended way to get one in.

agentPrompts.label: Mark an obligation done
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then mark the obligation I name as done and record the evidence note I give you.

agentPrompts.label: What obligations are overdue or due soon?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-clm` skill in this folder, then list the obligations that are overdue or due soon, grouped by owner, with their linked contract.
